content.text: weird jab at the end about Bruce not fighting in the ring. hmmm he did fight outside the ring where there are no rules but hey it’s ChuckBruce had real fights not in the ringThey can now resume their sparring session R I P you guys 😢Fact is Chuck Norris is undefeated karate world champion and won many fights, real fight, with official records. Bruce Lee never compete in real fight. Bruce is actor, not real fighter. If they fight for real, Chuck will mop the floor with Bruce LeeBruce Lee was a street fighter. Chuck Norris saying that punching a bag is a different kind of thing is a bit disrespectful, in my opinion, as he seems to be saying that Bruce Lee only ever kicked punching bags.The biggest icons in the world of martial arts: Bruce Lee, Chuck Norris, jcvd, Jet Li, Steven Seagal, Jackie Chan, Donnie yen 👏👏😍He finally met him again in heavenLow key trashing him a bit at the endTranslation: “he wouldn’t have stood a chance!”Had Bruce Lee lived much longer, I’m sure he would’ve repaid the favor to Chuck and lose to him in another fight in one of Chuck’s moviesIs Chuck stating on national TV that he would have beaten Bruce Lee is a real fight?
